build_M4C_model: build the M4C multimodal model by calling build to construct text, object, OCR, MMT, and output modules
review_MMT_forward: review the MMT forward method to understand how text, object, OCR, and decoder embeddings are fused
create_OcrPtrNet_pointer_network: create an OcrPtrNet pointer network module that computes attention scores between decoder output and OCR features
test_PrevPredEmbeddings: test the PrevPredEmbeddings module to verify it correctly embeds previous predictions with position and token type embeddings
summarize_M4C_forward_pass: summarize the M4C forward pass that encodes text, objects, and OCR then runs the multimodal transformer and classifier
